All through two agent tools and the `gh` CLI you already have"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"re called out on sight. All through two agent tools and the `gh` CLI you already have authenticated."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Just ask your agent in plain language — it picks the right tool:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- _"Watch CI on this repo and tell me when something fails"_ → starts a `ci_watch` background job.
-"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" _"Why did the nightly build fail?"_ → runs `ci_diagnose` on the latest failed run and hands you the"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" diagnosis card.
- _"Diagnose run 31782742089 on cli/cli"_ → targeted diagnosis of one specific run."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"You get a markdown diagnosis card straight in the chat:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**1. Watch — the `ci_watch` tool.** Starts a background job that polls for _new_ failed runs (the fi"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rst poll sets a baseline, so historical red runs never fire the alarm):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Streams status lines you can read any time; cancel any time.
- Backs off exponentially on transien"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"t errors, gives up after 5 consecutive failures, fails immediately on auth errors.
- On detection it"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" settles with a ready-made next step: `call ci_diagnose with repo="…" runId=…`.
- Watch a repo expli"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"citly, or omit `repo` to watch the current working directory's repository."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**2. Diagnose — the `ci_diagnose` tool.** Point it at a run (or the latest failed run) and it return"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"s the card shown above:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Error signatures are normalized (timestamps, hex ids, and numbers masked) so the _same_ failure ge"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ts the _same_ id across runs.
- Each signature is classified: test / build / lint / typecheck / depe"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ndency / network / permission / timeout / infra.
- Suspect files are mined from the log, vendor path"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"s dropped.
- Log excerpts are trimmed to a budget with honest `… (skipped N lines) …` markers — cont"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ent is never invented."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**3. The failure-signature ledger.** Every diagnosed signature is remembered — how many times seen, "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"first/last sighting, last repo and run URL. Repeat failures surface as `seen 3×` in the report inste"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ad of pretending to be new. The ledger persists as a `ci_doctor` storage unit in the DSH storage dir"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ectory when the profile provides a storage domain; it is in-memory otherwise."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Read-only by contract"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Both tools only ever _read_ GitHub state (via `gh api`). They never push, merge, cancel, rerun, or w"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"rite anything to your repositories. Every result carries a `repositoryWrites: false` marker, and the"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" package ships an optional invariant companion (`dsh-ci-doctor/invariant`) that fails loudly if a re"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"sult ever loses that marker on hosts with an `invariants` service."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Prerequisites: the GitHub CLI authenticated (`gh auth login`) — the plugin reuses that session, ther"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"e is nothing else to configure."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Option                | Default | Meaning                                   |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `pollIntervalSeconds` | `30`    | Seconds between watch polls (min 5).      |
| `watchTimeoutMinut"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"es` | `60`    | Wall-clock lifetime of one watch (min 1). |
| `maxLogLines`         | `200`   | Per-"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"job log excerpt budget (min 20).      |
| `ghBin`               | `gh`    | GitHub CLI executable.  "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"                  |
| `ledgerEnabled`       | `true`  | Record signatures into the ledger.        |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The plugin speaks to the host only through documented Cordis seams and imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` p"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"gin speaks to the host only through documented Cordis seams and imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- `tools` — registers `ci_watch` / `ci_diagnose` on the real tool runtime.
- `jobs` — `ci_watch` run"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"s as a first-class streaming background job, owned by the calling agent.
- `shell` — every `gh` call"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" goes through the host's guarded, sandboxed execution pipeline.
- `storageDomain` — the signature le"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"dger persists as the `ci_doctor` storage unit."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
